_about: Hand-maintained source of INDEX.md, docs/index.json and docs/README.md. Edit only this file, then run python tools/gen_indexes.py (preflight runs it too). To add a doc: add one line to a section under docs_readme_sections (every markdown file under docs/ needs one); to add a global source: add one object under sources.

index_md_head: Routing manifest for the global sources in this repository (LOS-74 decision Q11; LIFE-222). It says which file answers which question, what authority it has, who owns it and how to retrieve it. It contains no rules: every rule stays in the source it names, and the [Development Policy](docs/life-os-development-policy.md) decides precedence. GitHub `main` is canonical; record the commit SHA you read at task start (Q06).
Machine-readable twin: [`docs/index.json`](docs/index.json) (generated with this file). AGENTS.md is the master entrypoint; every other source is detail it routes to.

Project-specific context (requirements, workflows, configuration) is not here. It lives in the ChatGPT Project's Drive `PROJECT-INDEX.md` (LIFE-223); execution and status live in Jira `LIFE`, product decisions in Jira `LOS` (Q16).
index_md_tail: Generated from `docs/index-source.json` by `python tools/gen_indexes.py`; never edit this file. Add, rename or retire a global source in that source file (preflight regenerates, a contract test fails when stale). Other files under `docs/` are not listed: find them by listing the folder, each starts with its own heading (LIFE-644). `python -m lifeos.sources.devtools.readiness repo` and `tests/contracts/test_development_policy.py` fail when a listed path is missing, has no owner or authority, or is over the size limit.
docs_readme_head: Every markdown file under `docs/`, grouped by area, with what it is for and whether it is current or historical. `docs/index.json` is the routing index (task to docs). `tests/contracts/test_docs_index.py` fails when a doc is missing here or a link here points nowhere. Generated from `docs/index-source.json` by `python tools/gen_indexes.py`; never edit this file. Add a new doc as one line in that source file.
